none: PAS HAMP-751426: Roman coin : 'legionary' denarius of Mark Antony
contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman Republican denarius of Mark Antony dating to 32-31 BC, struck by a travelling mint. The reverse depicts a legionary eagle between two standards and the legend LEG XI, for Legio 11. To the obverse is a galley, right (oars and standard placed at the prow visible) with the legend ANT [AVG] above and III.VIR.R.P[C] below.
